name: EyeDrop AI Alt Text
author: EyeDrop AI

sections.description:
This is the official WordPress companion plugin for EyeDrop for Mac. When you upload an image that has been processed with EyeDrop’s Imprint feature, the plugin automatically reads the embedded AI-generated alt text and sets it as the image’s alt text, caption, or both on upload — no copying or pasting required.

To use this plugin, you’ll need EyeDrop for Mac. Learn more or download a free trial at https://eyedrop.ai.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen, or upload it manually to your site.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Upload an image processed with EyeDrop’s Imprint feature — the embedded alt text will be applied automatically.
sections.faq:
Do I need EyeDrop for Mac to use this plugin?

Yes. This plugin reads alt text embedded into images using EyeDrop’s Imprint feature. You can learn more and download a free trial at https://eyedrop.ai.

Does this plugin work with any image?

It currently supports JPEG, PNG, and WebP images that have had alt text embedded using EyeDrop’s Imprint feature. Support for additional formats is coming soon. Images without embedded alt text are not affected.

Is there a cost to use this plugin?

This plugin is free. EyeDrop for Mac is a one-time purchase with no subscription required.
